notes.text: This version features the word STRAWBERRY in either Side A or Side B or both sides runouts. It is otherwise identical to

in so far as it has the same outer and inner sleeves, the same label design/layout/font, country (UK) and so on, but does NOT feature the word STRAWBERRY in any runouts.
